## Checklist

- [ ] `cd app && npm run check` passes (typecheck, lint, format, tests)
- [ ] `cd app && npm run build` passes
- [ ] Tried the change in a browser with `cd app && npm run dev`
- [ ] If a new external host is used, it is added to the CSP in both `app/vite.config.ts` and `app/public/_headers`
